rationale: The agent did look up the user and orders, and appropriately escalated once it recognized refunds can only go to the original payment method or a gift card. However, it appears to have initiated a write action (return_delivered_order_items for order #W5490111 with a different payment method) without explicit user confirmation, violating the requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. It also did not complete returns for all items across both orders, so the user's request was not fully carried out. While acting on the correct user’s account seems fine and the final handoff rationale matches policy limits, the premature write and incomplete execution mean the outcome does not meet the pass bar.
